tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Calls, follow-ups, viewings and verifications — nothing heavier than that.

inquiries.emptyBody: Jot down who called and about what — it takes five seconds and saves an awkward callback.

inquiries.waiting_other: {{count}} inquiries waiting on you. Converting creates a client with the note attached.

archive.title: Archive & trash
archive.subtitle: Archived properties stay searchable. Deleted items wait 30 days before they go.
archive.emptyArchivedBody: Sold and withdrawn properties end up here instead of disappearing.
archive.deleteBody: It moves to Recently Deleted and can be restored for 30 days.
archive.emptyTrashBody: Deleted properties and clients wait here for 30 days.
archive.purgeNote: Items are permanently deleted after 30 days.
